scope: Standalone interactive UX proposal; no production runtime replacement or real account writes
browser_checks: One Down from detail primary reaches current category
Category changes update band and pressed state in place
Voice picker keeps episode page visible and returns focus to voice field
Provider picker only offers pairs present in captured videos
Local AnimeVost/CVH change leaves global NDA Studio/Kodik defaults intact
Back from scale chooser restores scale row focus
Search Enter preserves query and focuses matching title
Native 1000ms Enter hold opens a two-action panel without release activation
One OK from home requests demo resume of episode 4 with selected defaults
List counts derive from demo membership; favorites counted independently
Sort chooser returns focus to sort trigger
limitations: Public content is a stored API snapshot
Personal categories and progress are explicit demo state
No actual video launch or synchronization in this prototype
Real LG remote timing and device performance still require testing
